goal: Improve the app-first Velociraptor candidate by removing a vertical rear-foot artifact without changing the already acceptable tail, two-leg stance, folded forelimbs, side-profile body, or feather-mass read.

required: rear-foot cue must not read as a stray spike or plant stem
rejectIf: changed body, head, tail, or feather pattern
rear-foot artifact preserved as a vertical spike

experiments.finding: Selected as a count-level improvement. It removes the vertical rear-foot artifact while preserving the body, tail, legs, folded forelimbs, and current feather-mass read. Denoise 0.14 often preserved the artifact, while 0.30 over-softened the foot.

decision.reason: The selected rear-foot-only inpaint removes a misleading vertical foot artifact without introducing obvious limb-count errors, but the head reads too bird-like and the raised second-toe sickle claw remains too weak for representative promotion or positive LoRA training.
